import base64
import os

# label_decomposition chunks (ld3_00 to ld3_18) - 19 chunks
ld_chunks = []
# fig1_daf_scatter chunks (sc3_00 to sc3_16) - 17 chunks  
sc_chunks = []

# Read chunk files
for i in range(19):
    path = f"/tmp/ld3_{i:02d}.txt"
    with open(path) as f:
        ld_chunks.append(f.read().strip())

for i in range(17):
    path = f"/tmp/sc3_{i:02d}.txt"
    with open(path) as f:
        sc_chunks.append(f.read().strip())

# Concatenate and decode
ld_b64 = ''.join(ld_chunks)
sc_b64 = ''.join(sc_chunks)

ld_data = base64.b64decode(ld_b64)
sc_data = base64.b64decode(sc_b64)

print(f"label_decomposition: {len(ld_data)} bytes (expected 28372)")
print(f"fig1_daf_scatter: {len(sc_data)} bytes (expected 24488)")

# Write files
out_dir = "/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_12/projects/simgate-modular-routing/docs/paper/figures"
os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)

with open(os.path.join(out_dir, "label_decomposition.pdf"), "wb") as f:
    f.write(ld_data)
    
with open(os.path.join(out_dir, "fig1_daf_scatter.pdf"), "wb") as f:
    f.write(sc_data)

print("Files written successfully.")

# Verify
for name, expected in [("label_decomposition.pdf", 28372), ("fig1_daf_scatter.pdf", 24488)]:
    path = os.path.join(out_dir, name)
    actual = os.path.getsize(path)
    status = "OK" if actual == expected else "MISMATCH"
    print(f"  {name}: {actual} bytes [{status}]")
PYEOF
